flow.title: Power that takes care of itself.
flow.sub: From the grid to your home — Firefly watches over every second.
flow.step1_body: On a normal day, power flows through Firefly to your home and tops up the battery.
flow.step2_body: Your battery quietly holds a reserve, checked many times a second.
flow.step3_body: When grid power drops, Firefly switches to the battery in under 20 milliseconds.
flow.step4_body: Lights, internet, fridge and water keep running — most devices never even flicker.
flow.step5_body: If you have panels, sunshine refills the battery so you are ready for the next time.
flow.scene_sun_desc: Sunshine powers your home and charges the battery. The grid stays connected, with just a light draw.
flow.scene_night_desc: After dark the battery leads, with the grid ready to lend a hand. Your home stays fully powered.
flow.scene_outage_desc: The grid goes quiet — and your home stays on. Battery and solar carry the load without missing a beat.
flow.diagram_aria: Energy flow between solar, the Firefly inverter, your home, the battery and the grid
defense.title: Six ways Firefly keeps your home steady.
defense.sub: Whatever the grid does, your home keeps its calm.
defense.c1_body: When the grid goes dark, your home stays on — most devices won't even flicker.
defense.c2_body: On low voltage, Firefly switches to clean, steady battery power so your fridge, AC and well pump keep running and last longer.
defense.c3_body: Firefly isolates rough incoming power and delivers clean, stable power for sensitive electronics.
defense.c4_body: Firefly disconnects instantly, runs your home on battery and solar, then reconnects once power is safe again.
defense.c5_body: Your essentials run for hours on battery and solar — often longer, as solar refills the battery through the day.
defense.c6_body: Firefly adds strong surge protection. For your most valuable electronics, we still recommend point-of-use surge protectors too.

industrial.hero.h1: Energy storage that pays for itself — and protects everything.
industrial.hero.sub: Battery energy storage and solar self-supply, engineered for your facility. Lower your demand charges, keep production running through outages, and take control of what energy costs your business.
industrial.hero.image_alt: Battery energy storage cabinets installed at an industrial facility at dusk.
industrial.props.title: Four ways storage works for your operation.
industrial.props.sub: Every facility is different. Most see two or three of these compound at once.
industrial.props.p1.title: Peak shaving
industrial.props.p1.summary: Cut the demand charges that drive your bill.
industrial.props.p1.problem: Under GDMTH tariffs, a large share of your bill comes from your highest 15-minute demand peak — not just total energy used. A few short spikes each month can set the rate you pay across the whole period.
industrial.props.p1.solves: The battery discharges precisely during those load peaks, shaving the spikes your meter records. Your facility draws less from the grid at exactly the moments that cost the most, so your billed demand comes down.
industrial.props.p1.deliver: We profile your load, size storage to your peak shape, and configure automatic discharge so demand-charge reduction happens without anyone on your team lifting a finger.
industrial.props.p2.title: Backup at scale
industrial.props.p2.summary: Production lines, cold chains and operations ride through outages.
industrial.props.p2.problem: An outage on a production line, a cold-storage room, or a critical process is lost product, lost hours, and restart costs — sometimes far more than the power itself was ever worth.
industrial.props.p2.solves: Storage carries your critical loads through grid interruptions, switching over fast enough that sensitive equipment keeps running. Operations continue while the grid sorts itself out.
industrial.props.p2.deliver: We map your critical loads, size capacity for the runtime you need, and engineer the transfer so the right circuits stay live — cold chain, process control, safety systems first.
industrial.props.p3.title: Solar + storage self-supply
industrial.props.p3.summary: Generate and store your own energy, hedge tariff increases.
industrial.props.p3.problem: Energy costs rise and your facility has little control over the rate. Daytime consumption tracks the most expensive hours, and there's no buffer when tariffs move.
industrial.props.p3.solves: Generate your own power on-site and store what you don't use immediately. You draw on stored energy during costly periods, shifting more of your consumption off the grid and locking in a predictable cost for years.
industrial.props.p3.deliver: We design generation and storage to your consumption profile, with monitoring that shows exactly how much of your load you're self-supplying day to day.
industrial.props.p4.title: Power quality
industrial.props.p4.summary: Stable, clean power for sensitive equipment.
industrial.props.p4.problem: Voltage sags, surges and instability shorten the life of motors, drives and electronics, and can trip sensitive process equipment mid-run.
industrial.props.p4.solves: Storage and its power-conversion stage sit between the grid and your loads, smoothing disturbances and holding voltage steady so your equipment sees clean, consistent power.
industrial.props.p4.deliver: We assess your power-quality issues, specify conversion sized to your loads, and verify stable delivery to the circuits that matter most.

industrial.equip.e1.body: Floor-standing battery cabinets for commercial and light-industrial sites, placed in an indoor or covered location. Long-cycle-life chemistry sized from tens of kWh upward.
industrial.equip.e2.title: Containerized BESS
industrial.equip.e2.body: Fully integrated storage in a transportable enclosure with built-in power conversion and climate management. Scales to MWh capacity for plant-level demand and self-supply.
industrial.equip.e3.title: Three-phase hybrid PCS / inverters
industrial.equip.e3.body: Hybrid power-conversion units that manage solar, storage and grid together. Units parallel to reach the power your facility needs, from tens to hundreds of kW.
industrial.equip.e4.title: Monitoring & EMS
industrial.equip.e4.body: An energy-management layer that meters loads, schedules discharge, and reports performance with remote telemetry and proactive alerts — so the system earns its keep and you always know its state.
